claim_ceiling: The mechanically valid defect class definitions (D2 letterhead zone, D3 markup residue, D4 language marker mismatch) are frozen from committed RULES.json. These definitions are sufficient to build a deterministic, model-free content quality filter that rejects only mechanical scaffolding artifacts before the frozen confirm-or-abstain gate. The filter implementation is pending one REVISE cycle; the claim ceiling represents the maximum claim this work currently supports: that the three defect classes are mechanically definable and, when implemented in a deterministic filter, will reject all 14 known defective rows with zero false rejections on the confirmed set.
